gate: R1-005 P0 — external tarball consumer + real Harness smoke gate

cases.requirement: R1-004 governance exact head 2eb227f2fb54f9249ddde9739bb7e2e515d96ba8 is normal-CI and exact-Harness dual-green before R1-005 repository work begins.
PR #3 remains Open/Draft/unmerged; R1-006+, M5-003+, registry publish, GitHub Release/tag and merge/Ready remain unauthorized.
The Adapter under test is a real @dsh-safe/adapter-dsh@0.1.0-alpha.0 .tgz produced by the accepted R1-004 build/pack path, not a workspace/source substitute.
The consumer is created outside the safe-runtime repository and outside every participating pnpm workspace root.
The consumer has its own package manifest, installation state and runtime entrypoint and does not reuse repository node_modules as its runtime dependency tree.
Consumer runtime resolution uses no workspace:, link:, source-directory file: dependency, npm/pnpm link, NODE_PATH source injection or undeclared relative source path.
The supported Harness baseline remains exactly 0.1.0-rc.5 at commit 47f943859bef60e4160492346772ded9b24f765a; rc6/latest/next/range substitution is forbidden.
EXTERNAL_TARBALL_CONSUMER_VERIFIED and PUBLIC_REGISTRY_INSTALL_VERIFIED are separate claims; the latter is not implied by source-backed tarball installation.
Failure to resolve an exact accepted rc5 package publicly cannot be repaired by silently selecting a newer or ranged version.
If required, the peer bridge checks out exactly the pinned Harness commit and verifies HEAD before producing any runtime package artifact.
The peer bridge uses reproducible upstream installation/build inputs and packs real npm-compatible tarballs rather than installing upstream source directories into the consumer.
The source bridge computes the complete runtime workspace-package closure needed by the exact Adapter peer set rather than hand-picking only direct peers.
Every transitive upstream workspace dependency affecting the tested runtime path resolves at the exact accepted version from registry or an exact-source packed tarball; unresolved closure fails.
Every source-bridge tarball has the package name/version expected from the pinned commit and contains no surviving workspace: dependency locator.
The Gate records package name/version, source authority, archive filename and SHA-256 for the Adapter and each local bridge tarball.
A real package-manager install is executed inside the external consumer using the Adapter tarball and exact runtime package inputs.
After install, @dsh-safe/adapter-dsh resolves from the consumer installation tree and not from the safe-runtime source repository.
Harness/Cordis runtime packages used by smoke tests resolve from the consumer installation tree and not from the pinned Harness source checkout or safe-runtime node_modules.
Smoke tests import only the installed @dsh-safe/adapter-dsh public package root and do not deep-import package-private binding/plugin/ports/source-conformance/src paths.
Smoke tests execute the actual installed rc5 Cordis/Harness ToolRuntime/approval pipeline; a structural fake cannot satisfy this Gate.
HANDLER ALLOW reaches the real policy handler exactly once, enters one test-owned tool body, returns the expected benign result and creates no approval request.
HANDLER DENY reaches policy once, creates no approval request and proves the real test-owned tool body does not enter.
HANDLER ASK with native ALLOWED_ONCE creates exactly one native approval request and permits later tool-body entry subject to later guards.
HANDLER ASK with native REJECTED creates exactly one native approval request and the tool body does not enter.
CANCELLED and UNAVAILABLE ASK outcomes, when exercised, remain fail-closed and cannot become body entry or implicit allow.
One reached ASK is owned by one native ToolRuntime approval path; the external plugin does not invoke a duplicate Adapter approval subsystem for the same request.
Omitted plugin policy installs the accepted DENY_ALL behavior and proves a real test-owned tool body cannot enter.
Default DENY_ALL behavior depends on the accepted pre-execute DENY plus monotonic guard DENY and is tested through the installed public plugin API, not an internal helper.

The installed exact rc5 Adapter publicly reports every feature required by the selected plugin mode as present; R1-005 must not fabricate a missing-feature runtime. A future separately accepted baseline that truthfully lacks a required feature must exercise the inherited fail-closed activation branch.
await fiber.dispose() settles only after Adapter-owned registrations are removed; later requests in the caller-owned Context are not handled by stale plugin registrations.
Plugin disposal does not dispose the caller-owned root Context or unrelated caller-owned services/listeners.

External smoke is reproducible from clean checkout/install state without prior Adapter dist, developer-global packages, secret credentials, unpublished local registry state or repository node_modules runtime resolution.
All Adapter-declared direct Harness/Cordis peers installed for the smoke exactly match the R1-004 peer contract before runtime assertions execute.
Conflicting duplicate package identities/versions affecting the tested runtime path fail the consumer audit rather than being silently tolerated.
The external harness fails if runtime resolution points under the safe-runtime source root, pinned Harness source root, or a source workspace package path.
R1-005 adds no Adapter install-time scripts, publish credentials or registry-token requirement merely to make external smoke succeed.
R1-005 external-consumer infrastructure does not introduce new policy, approval, lifecycle, capability, provider/resource or Harness event semantics.

Acceptance may claim EXTERNAL_TARBALL_CONSUMER_VERIFIED and EXACT_RC5_RUNTIME_SMOKE_VERIFIED but not public-registry installability, future Harness compatibility, release provenance, process isolation or complete mediation without separate evidence.
The same final implementation SHA passes normal CI, exact pinned Harness source typecheck/runtime conformance, external consumer install/path/version audits and all required runtime smokes.

Before protocol-first dual-green, repository delta is limited to Spec 0059, this corpus and CURRENT; executable consumer scripts/tests, package scripts, lockfile, production/conformance, HISTORY, roadmap R1-005 marker, R1-006+, publish/release/merge changes are forbidden.
